<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 500 420" width="100%" height="100%">
  <!-- White Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Styles -->
  <style>
    text {
      font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      fill: #000000;
    }
    .math {
      font-family: "Times New Roman", Times, serif;
      font-style: italic;
    }
    .bold {
      font-weight: bold;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Title / Caption -->
  <text x="250" y="395" text-anchor="middle" class="bold">Fig. 3.1</text>

  <!-- ==================== APPARATUS ==================== -->

  <!-- Beaker / Glass Container -->
  <!-- Outer walls, flat bottom -->
  <path d="M 120 120 L 120 310 C 120 325 130 330 140 330 L 360 330 C 370 330 380 325 380 310 L 380 120" 
        fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  
  <!-- Liquid level (dilute NaCl solution) -->
  <path d="M 121 160 L 379 160" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3"/>
  <rect x="121" y="160" width="258" height="169" fill="#f0f4f8" opacity="0.5"/>
  <text x="250" y="240" text-anchor="middle" fill="#555555" font-size="13">dilute sodium chloride</text>
  <text x="250" y="258" text-anchor="middle" fill="#555555" font-size="13">solution</text>

  <!-- DC Power Supply / Battery symbol -->
  <g transform="translate(250, 60)">
    <!-- Connecting wires from power supply -->
    <path d="M 0 10 L -120 10 L -120 70" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <path d="M 0 10 L 120 10 L 120 70" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <!-- Battery lines -->
    <line x1="-20" y1="0" x2="-20" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="-10" y1="5" x2="-10" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="20" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="3"/>
    <line x1="10" y1="5" x2="10" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
    
    <!-- Terminals labels -->
    <text x="-15" y="-5" text-anchor="middle" class="bold">+</text>
    <text x="5" y="-5" text-anchor="middle" class="bold">-</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Carbon Electrodes (Anode left, Cathode right) -->
  <!-- Anode (Left) -->
  <rect x="130" y="130" width="20" height="130" fill="#333333" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="-120" y1="70" x2="140" y2="70" stroke="none"/> <!-- wire anchor point visually handled above -->

  <!-- Cathode (Right) -->
  <rect x="350" y="130" width="20" height="130" fill="#333333" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Inverted Test Tubes over Electrodes -->
  <!-- Left Test Tube (Anode / Gas X) -->
  <path d="M 115 80 L 115 230 C 115 240 120 245 130 245 L 140 245 C 150 245 155 240 155 230 L 155 80 Z" 
        fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Gas pocket left (shorter volume, Gas X) -->
  <line x1="115" y1="120" x2="155" y2="120" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <text x="135" y="105" text-anchor="middle" class="bold">Gas X</text>

  <!-- Right Test Tube (Cathode / Gas Y - about twice the volume) -->
  <path d="M 335 50 L 335 230 C 335 240 340 245 350 245 L 360 245 C 370 245 375 240 375 230 L 375 50 Z" 
        fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Gas pocket right (larger volume, Gas Y) -->
  <line x1="335" y1="90" x2="375" y2="90" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <text x="355" y="75" text-anchor="middle" class="bold">Gas Y</text>


  <!-- ==================== LABELS & POINTERS ==================== -->

  <!-- Anode label and pointer -->
  <text x="60" y="180" text-anchor="end">anode</text>
  <path d="M 68 176 L 128 176" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <polygon points="128,176 122,173 122,179" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Cathode label and pointer -->
  <text x="440" y="180" text-anchor="start">cathode</text>
  <path d="M 432 176 L 372 176" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <polygon points="372,176 378,173 378,179" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Inert carbon electrode label and pointer -->
  <text x="60" y="220" text-anchor="end">inert carbon electrode</text>
  <path d="M 68 216 L 138 216" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <polygon points="138,216 132,213 132,219" fill="#000000"/>

</svg>

issues: The label 'electrode' points directly to the solid rectangular bar, but the label 'anode' also points to the same rectangular bar (the carbon electrode), which is confusing and redundant since the bar itself is the electrode and the anode is a type of electrode.

Question (c) asks the student to explain why the volume of gas Y collected is about twice the volume of gas X, but in the diagram (Fig. 3.1), the volume of Gas Y shown in the test tube is visually smaller than or roughly equal to Gas X, whereas it should show a noticeably larger volume (twice the height) to correctly reflect the stoichiometry of water electrolysis.
